source.note: Public repository downloaded as an archive and inspected read-only. Its .env (real backend credentials) was excluded from inspection and is never copied into this project.

capabilities.capability: application code, 255 routes, components, MDX documentation content
capabilities.source: src/, public/, vite.config.ts docs-catalog + MDX plugins

capabilities.outcome: copied as real files (required: the app is also deployed outside Lovable)
merged; this project's pinned TanStack Start/Router/Vite/Nitro versions kept

capabilities.capability: database schema (176 tables, 174 reviewed SQL scripts)
capabilities.outcome: kept in the repository for review; not applied automatically
capabilities.next_action: Decide the target backend: run against the original Neon database, or rebuild the schema in Lovable Cloud. Then apply the reviewed scripts.

capabilities.capability: application records (profiles, links, bookings, workspaces, analytics)
capabilities.next_action: Provide CSV/JSON exports of the application tables from Neon.

capabilities.source: Neon (better-auth tables: user, account, session, passkey, organization, member)
capabilities.next_action: Provide a users export (email addresses and original user IDs) to import; existing users then verify email and set a new password.

capabilities.capability: sign-in and sessions (better-auth, httpOnly rout_session cookie, passkeys, 2FA, OIDC provider)
capabilities.outcome: code preserved as-is; needs a database to function
capabilities.next_action: After the backend decision, verify sign-up, sign-in, passkey and OIDC flows end to end.

capabilities.capability: authorization and row-level security (rout_app least-privilege role, RLS, admin grants, audit chain)
capabilities.outcome: code preserved; RLS lives in the database and must be recreated with the schema
capabilities.next_action: Recreate role + RLS in the chosen backend and verify one member cannot read another's rows.

capabilities.source: Scaleway Object Storage (SCALEWAY_* / S3_* variables, aws4fetch signing)
capabilities.next_action: Supply Scaleway keys securely in chat when verification is ready, or switch uploads to Lovable Cloud storage.

capabilities.source: Brevo (BREVO_* variables, react-email templates, template sync scripts)
capabilities.next_action: Supply Brevo API key and sender addresses securely in chat when verification is ready.

capabilities.source: Stripe (checkout, webhook, status polling) and bunq
capabilities.next_action: Supply Stripe secret/publishable/webhook keys and bunq credentials securely in chat; keep the same Stripe account.
Gateway key is issued by Lovable; verify bio-assistance and contact triage after the backend runs.

capabilities.source: Steam, Last.fm, YouTube, GitHub, Bluesky/AT Protocol, Mastodon, Proton, Telegram
capabilities.next_action: Supply the provider keys/redirect URIs the member actually uses; unused ones stay inactive.

capabilities.capability: public endpoints and callbacks (OIDC discovery/JWKS, AT Protocol DID, MCP server, agent API, webhooks, ICS, cron handlers)
capabilities.outcome: copied unchanged so external callers keep working
capabilities.next_action: Point external callers (Vercel deploy, schedulers, OAuth apps) at the new address during cutover.

capabilities.capability: schedules (asset cleanup, webhook delivery, availability, DNS checks, audit checkpoints, account purge)
capabilities.outcome: handlers copied; no scheduler is attached to this project
capabilities.next_action: Re-create the cron schedules against the new address and supply the cron secret.

capabilities.capability: secrets (about 45 names: DATABASE_URL, PUBLIC_ORIGIN, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, signing/encryption keys, provider keys)
capabilities.outcome: no values copied; names documented in ENVIRONMENT.md
capabilities.next_action: Enter values through Lovable's secure secret form when verification is ready.

capabilities.capability: custom domains and wildcard subdomains (*.rout.be, member domains)
capabilities.next_action: Cutover decision: which domain this deployment answers, plus DNS.

capabilities.outcome: build, typecheck and unit tests run in this project
capabilities.next_action: Run the suite; live business flows stay blocked until a database is connected.
